title: Professional Business Communication Training
quote: Martin is a great trainer - he helps put you at ease so you feel like you can contribute to the meeting and is very personable. I found the workshop helpful and it made me think about how I should be adapting my communication when working away from the office. I was surprised at how well the class worked via Zoom. I have marked 4 stars just to some technical glitches which is not the trainers fault and also because I had hoped this might cover some written communication as well.
author: Kelly Firmin
subject: Professional Business Communication
